# INSIGHTS — summarized, verified findings (accumulate across the whole run)

The JOURNAL is your per-iteration diary; THIS file is the distilled, VERIFIED takeaway a future iteration should read instead of re-reading the whole journal or old sessions/traces. Update it whenever you have a genuinely NEW, confirmed finding (an accepted/rejected RESULT counts as confirmation; a guess does not) — not every iteration needs a new entry. Structure each addition as:

    ## <task or mechanism name>
    - What worked (confirmed by a RESULT, cite the candidate id):
    - What didn't (confirmed by a RESULT, cite the candidate id):
    - Promising but not yet tried:

## tau2-airline — enforce "the API does not check …" rules in tool code
- What worked (pending a RESULT — not yet confirmed): converting the policy's explicitly un-enforced rules (bag allowance = (cabin base+membership bonus)×pax; payment-method caps 1 cert/1 card/3 gift cards; basic-economy-no-flight-change; no-cabin-change-after-flown) into in-body guards that RAISE (never auto-correct). Rationale: compliant calls stay byte-identical to the seed, so regression risk is confined to false-positive guards, which the exact policy formulas avoid.
- What didn't (not yet confirmed): cancel-eligibility and compensation resist a pure code guard because one leg ("reason covered by insurance" / explicit request + confirmed facts) is a judgment call — a deterministic guard there would false-positive. Left to prose this round.
- Promising but not yet tried: a SEMI-deterministic cancel guard enforcing only the objective legs (24h from created_at, business cabin, airline-cancelled status, insurance flag present) while leaving the "covered reason" leg to the agent; enriched return values that echo the computed free-bag allowance so the model fills nonfree correctly on the first call.
